name: NordVPN
summary: Consumer VPN with threat protection, sold on two-year plans that renew at a higher yearly rate. Teams buy Nord's separate business product, NordLayer.
best_for: individuals and households who want an easy personal VPN and will set a reminder before the two-year plan renews
skip_if: you're buying for a team: these are consumer plans; Nord's business product is NordLayer, from $8 per user a month with a five-user minimum
honest_knock: The €3.49 is a two-year introductory rate: Basic renews at €139.08 a year, about €11.59 a month, roughly three times what you signed up at. It's a solid, easy VPN, but a VPN is one layer of security, not a whole strategy: don't mistake it for endpoint protection.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month on the two-year plan (€94.23 for the first 27 months), renewing at €139.08 a year
pricing.notes: (consumer plans re-verified 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-14 in the browser, unchanged; the page is geo-priced and served us euros from a Dutch address) Consumer two-year plans: Basic €3.49/mo, Complete €4.49/mo and Ultimate Max €8.49/mo, each with three extra months. They are charged as €94.23, €121.23 and €229.23 for the first 27 months, with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Read the renewal line before you buy: those same plans renew at €139.08, €219.48 and €338.28 a year, so Basic goes from about €3.49 a month to about €11.59 — roughly a threefold step. The business product, NordLayer, is quoted in USD worldwide — read from a European address the page still prints dollars and states priceCurrency USD — and it publishes both billing cycles. Per user per month: Lite $8 on annual billing or $10 month-to-month, Core $11 or $14, Premium $14 or $18, which the toggle labels as savings of 20%, 21% and 22%. There is a five-user minimum and a 14-day money-back guarantee, and Core and Premium require a dedicated-IP server on top: +$40 a month on annual billing, +$50 month-to-month (both toggles re-read on 3 October 2026). An enterprise offer starts at $6 per user per month on annual billing, or $10 month-to-month, from 200 seats and with Lite capabilities. On 14 October 2026 the annual NordLayer prices, the dedicated-IP add-on and the enterprise offer were unchanged; the monthly figures were not re-read that day. Two endpoint add-ons sit beside the ladder: CrowdStrike Falcon Go at $2 per device a month and CrowdStrike Falcon Enterprise at $9. Two things changed between our readings and neither is a price. The top tier was called Ultimate Pro on 17 August 2026 and is called Ultimate Max on 14 September 2026, with the same €8.49 introductory rate and the same €338.28 renewal; it is also the only consumer tier that includes a dedicated IP and the cyber insurance, which pays out up to €5,000 per covered claim. The NordLayer ladder was re-read on 14 September 2026 on nordlayer.com/pricing and the three seat rates are unchanged from 17 August; what is new here is the month-to-month column and the two CrowdStrike add-ons, taken from the plan data the page serves itself. The consumer page was read again on 2 October 2026 with every intro rate, 27-month charge and renewal unchanged; nordlayer.com/pricing served us a bot check that day, so the NordLayer figures stand as read on 14 September 2026.
